name: How do I know if a tile installer is qualified for my bathroom project?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a tile installer is qualified for my bathroom project?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should ask for proof that the installer has experience with bathrooms, showers, waterproofing, and stone fabrication if needed. Clear photos of past work, a written scope, and material recommendations are more useful than vague promises.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for bathroom-specific experience, photos of similar work, and a written plan for waterproofing and prep. If they cannot explain how they handle wet areas, that is a warning sign.
